schema.name: access_grant
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `access_grant` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`organization_id` text NOT NULL REFERENCES `organization`(`id`),
	`scope_kind` text NOT NULL CHECK (`scope_kind` IN ('organization', 'project', 'work_package')),
	`scope_id` text NOT NULL,
	`subject_kind` text NOT NULL CHECK (`subject_kind` IN ('user', 'group', 'organization_members', 'machine_credential')),
	`subject_id` text NOT NULL,
	`role_id` text NOT NULL REFERENCES `access_role`(`id`),
	`origin` text NOT NULL CHECK (`origin` IN ('backfill', 'route', 'invitation', 'creation', 'operator')),
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`created_by` text REFERENCES `users`(`id`),
	CONSTRAINT `access_grant_organization_scope` CHECK (`scope_kind` <> 'organization' OR `scope_id` = `organization_id`),
	UNIQUE (`organization_id`, `scope_kind`, `scope_id`, `subject_kind`, `subject_id`, `role_id`)
)

)

schema.name: access_role
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `access_role` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`object_kind` text NOT NULL CHECK (`object_kind` IN ('organization', 'project', 'work_package')),
	`level` integer CHECK (`level` BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
	`reaches_restricted` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL CONSTRAINT `access_role_reaches_restricted` CHECK (`reaches_restricted` IN (0, 1)),
	`organization_id` text REFERENCES `organization`(`id`),
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer,
	`created_by` text REFERENCES `users`(`id`),
	CONSTRAINT `access_role_built_in_or_custom` CHECK ((`organization_id` IS NULL) = (`level` IS NOT NULL)),
	CONSTRAINT `access_role_built_in_name` CHECK (`organization_id` IS NOT NULL OR `name` = `id`),

CREATE TRIGGER `step_measure_keys_legacy_fact`
AFTER INSERT ON `step_measure`
WHEN NEW.`measure_id` IS NULL AND NEW.`metric` IN ('token_actual', 'hours_actual')
BEGIN
	UPDATE `step_measure` SET `measure_id` = (
		SELECT m.`id` FROM `work_item` AS w
		JOIN "work_package_organization" AS po ON po.`resource_id` = w."work_package_id"
		JOIN `measure` AS m ON m.`organization_id` = po.`organization_id`
			AND m.`key` = CASE NEW.`metric` WHEN 'token_actual' THEN 'tokens' ELSE 'hours' END
		WHERE w.`id` = NEW.`work_item_id`
	)
	WHERE `rowid` = NEW.`rowid`;
END

CREATE TRIGGER `step_measure_mirrors_token_estimate_delete`
AFTER DELETE ON `step_measure`
WHEN OLD.`metric` = 'token_estimate'
BEGIN
	DELETE FROM `measure_estimate`
	WHERE `work_item_id` = OLD.`work_item_id` AND `step_id` = OLD.`step_id`
		AND `measure_key` = 'tokens' AND `single_point` = 1;
END

schema.name: step_measure_mirrors_token_estimate_insert
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER `step_measure_mirrors_token_estimate_insert`
AFTER INSERT ON `step_measure`
WHEN NEW.`metric` = 'token_estimate'
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO `measure_estimate`
		(`work_item_id`, `step_id`, `measure_key`, `measure_id`, `optimistic`, `realistic`, `pessimistic`, `single_point`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `created_by`)
	SELECT NEW.`work_item_id`, NEW.`step_id`, 'tokens', (
			SELECT m.`id` FROM `work_item` AS w
			JOIN "work_package_organization" AS po ON po.`resource_id` = w."work_package_id"
			JOIN `measure` AS m ON m.`organization_id` = po.`organization_id` AND m.`key` = 'tokens'
			WHERE w.`id` = NEW.`work_item_id`
		),
		NEW.`value`, NEW.`value`, NEW.`value`, 1, NEW.`created_at`, NEW.`updated_at`, NEW.`created_by`
	WHERE 1
	ON CONFLICT (`work_item_id`, `step_id`, `measure_key`) DO UPDATE SET
		`optimistic` = excluded.`optimistic`, `realistic` = excluded.`realistic`,
		`pessimistic` = excluded.`pessimistic`, `single_point` = 1,
		`updated_at` = excluded.`updated_at`;
END

schema.name: step_measure_mirrors_token_estimate_update
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER `step_measure_mirrors_token_estimate_update`
AFTER UPDATE OF `work_item_id`, `step_id`, `metric`, `value` ON `step_measure`
WHEN OLD.`metric` = 'token_estimate' OR NEW.`metric` = 'token_estimate'
BEGIN
	DELETE FROM `measure_estimate`
	WHERE OLD.`metric` = 'token_estimate' AND `work_item_id` = OLD.`work_item_id`
		AND `step_id` = OLD.`step_id` AND `measure_key` = 'tokens' AND `single_point` = 1;
	INSERT INTO `measure_estimate`
		(`work_item_id`, `step_id`, `measure_key`, `measure_id`, `optimistic`, `realistic`, `pessimistic`, `single_point`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `created_by`)
	SELECT NEW.`work_item_id`, NEW.`step_id`, 'tokens', (
			SELECT m.`id` FROM `work_item` AS w
			JOIN "work_package_organization" AS po ON po.`resource_id` = w."work_package_id"
			JOIN `measure` AS m ON m.`organization_id` = po.`organization_id` AND m.`key` = 'tokens'
			WHERE w.`id` = NEW.`work_item_id`
		),
		NEW.`value`, NEW.`value`, NEW.`value`, 1, NEW.`created_at`, NEW.`updated_at`, NEW.`created_by`
	WHERE NEW.`metric` = 'token_estimate'
	ON CONFLICT (`work_item_id`, `step_id`, `measure_key`) DO UPDATE SET
		`optimistic` = excluded.`optimistic`, `realistic` = excluded.`realistic`,
		`pessimistic` = excluded.`pessimistic`, `single_point` = 1,
		`updated_at` = excluded.`updated_at`;

 CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_package_organization WHERE resource_id=NEW.id)
 THEN 'org:' || (SELECT organization_id FROM work_package_organization WHERE resource_id=NEW.id)
 ELSE 'legacy' END,
 char(65 + ((next-1) / 456976) % 26, 65 + ((next-1) / 17576) % 26, 65 + ((next-1) / 676) % 26, 65 + ((next-1) / 26) % 26, 65 + ((next-1) / 1) % 26)
 FROM work_package_abbreviation_counter WHERE singleton=1;
END

WITH RECURSIVE candidate(ordinal, abbreviation) AS (
 SELECT next, char(65 + ((next) / 456976) % 26, 65 + ((next) / 17576) % 26, 65 + ((next) / 676) % 26, 65 + ((next) / 26) % 26, 65 + ((next) / 1) % 26) FROM work_package_abbreviation_counter WHERE singleton=1 AND next < 11881376
 UNION ALL
 SELECT ordinal+1, char(65 + ((ordinal+1) / 456976) % 26, 65 + ((ordinal+1) / 17576) % 26, 65 + ((ordinal+1) / 676) % 26, 65 + ((ordinal+1) / 26) % 26, 65 + ((ordinal+1) / 1) % 26) FROM candidate
 WHERE ordinal+1 < 11881376
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_package_abbreviation WHERE abbreviation=candidate.abbreviation)
)
SELECT ordinal FROM candidate
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_package_abbreviation WHERE abbreviation=candidate.abbreviation)
LIMIT 1
